referenceFunction.generalComment: Description of all flows of materials and energy due to the throughput of 1kg crude oil in the refinery. The multioutput-process 'crude oil, in refinery' delivers the co-products petrol, unleaded, bitumen, diesel, light fuel oil, heavy fuel oil, kerosene, naphtha, propane/ butane, refinery gas, secondary sulphur and electricity. The impacts of processing are allocated to the different products with flow specific allocation factors described in the report.; UUID: 269b8c82-6dd0-39cd-a773-33608bbc5ebc
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: All processes on the refinery site, including energy use and emissions from combustion facilities, including waste water treatment, process emissions and direct discharges to rivers.
referenceFunction.name: Kerosene, at refinery

timePeriod.text: Statistical data for the throughput and production volumes were available for the year 2016. Major indicators like energy use have been estimated based on a survey in European refineries. Other data and indicators have been estimated based on different environmental reports and statistical data sources.

representativeness.extrapolations: Some data were available only for single plants and have been extrapolated to the European situation.
representativeness.productionVolume: 676 million tonnes crude oil for 2016 in 90 refineries in RER
representativeness.samplingProcedure: Reference document of the European Commission, environmental reports, public statistics and literature data.
